contentBlocks.text: If you recently acquired a high-end car from an auction or had a mishap on the road, you can’t trust any luxury auto body shop to have the skill and expertise to restore your prized possession to its original glory.

Meticulous attention to detail and cutting-edge technology are at the core of our craftsmanship. At StreetWorks Exotics, we have experienced coachbuilders skilled in using English wheels, power hammers, Kraftformers, and shrinking techniques to create the perfect panels for your car.

From a flat piece of aluminum or steel to perfectly shaped and fitted panels, we use the correct, original techniques to maintain your car’s authenticity. From minor dents to full structural repairs, we strive for perfection in every job.

Our unwavering commitment to quality means that we spare no expense in providing top-of-the-line foreign and classic car bodywork for the best results every time. Hand-built cars require hand-built solutions. If you are looking for an exotic car body shop you can trust, choose nothing less than StreetWorks Exotics.
